_about: App definitions for the agent's general tools: data, not code. A new app is an entry here. 'link_schemes' lists the app links open() may follow (anything else is refused). A new_item kind is offered to the model only when its 'requires_scheme' is registered on this PC. Templates are filled with URL-encoded fields; 'recipients' fields are kept only if the user said the address. Nothing here ever sends: each kind opens a draft the user reviews.

event._note: New Outlook opens .ics files as 'Add calendar' (an import), not as one event, so events use Outlook's own pre-filled 'new event' page; it saves only when the user clicks Save. Personal accounts use outlook.live.com; work or school accounts use outlook.office.com instead.
